comment: Raw source mirror registry (D34). The GitHub repository is the source of truth for every file here. serve: tracked markdown files whose full text is mirrored LF-normalized under site/public/raw/ at build time; their Atlas filename headings link to the served copy. reference: tracked markdown files whose Atlas headings link to the file on GitHub instead (repository access required) because their full text sits behind the redaction tier (D21/D23: schedules, machine paths, custody detail, seat coordinates, probe adjacency). Files in neither list keep unlinked headings (described, not shown). Guarded by build-site.mjs and verify-site check 13: serve is markdown-only, never a protected identity or probe path, byte-checked against the repository file, and scanned by the redaction walls.
